title: DistributionJob
description: One publication package for one episode on one platform. HOSPES never publishes: the job carries the prepared package, the human authorization receipt that permits a publication, and the external identifier of a publication a human already performed. The metadata is one of three validated families - rss, video, or clip - selected by the platform.

distribution_id.description: Stable identity of this publication job.

family.description: Package family the platform carries. rss->rss, youtube->video, every short-form platform and clip_queue->clip.

target_platform.description: Short-form destination for a clip package; null for an episode-level job.

status.description: blocked means an uncleared rights item or an unfilled committed sponsor slot denies publication; failed records a delivery attempt that did not succeed and stays retryable.

metadata.description: The validated package. Only the fields of the platform's family are accepted; anything else is refused at the write boundary.

package_checksum.description: SHA-256 over the canonical package, carried into every delivery receipt as payload_checksum.

authorization_receipt_ref.description: Identity of the authorization_receipts row that permits publishing this job. Required before schedule, publication, or failure.

scheduled_at.description: Future moment the authorized publication is planned for.

external_id.description: Deprecated alias of external_id_ref, retained for older readers.

external_id_ref.description: The platform's identifier for the published artifact. Immutable once recorded.

attempt_count.description: Delivery attempts recorded so far; every attempt has its own delivery receipt.

last_error_ref.description: Opaque custody reference to the evidence for the most recent failed attempt.

idempotency_key.description: Re-drafting under the same key returns the existing job instead of a second one.

chapters.description: Ordered chapter marks. Starts are distinct and ascending.

reference.description: A public https URL or an opaque custody reference. Contact-like values are refused.

rss_package.description: Podcast RSS item. Only the title is required to draft; description, audio_url, and duration are reported as outstanding until present.

video_package.description: YouTube metadata. Tags are distinct, bounded, and stay inside the platform's character budget.

clip_package.description: One short-form clip window on the episode timeline. The caption stays an opaque custody reference to its external owner.
